expected.title: Generic flatness over a reduced base: an open dense locus on which a finite type morphism and a finite type sheaf are flat and of finite presentation
expected.author: The Stacks Project Authors
expected.difficulty_reason: The proposition is the reduced-base form of generic flatness: for a finite type morphism f : X to S with S reduced and a finite type quasi-coherent sheaf F on X there is an open dense U of S over which X is flat and of finite presentation and F is flat over U and of finite presentation over O_X (statement lines 5246-5260). The counted proof has a real assembly layer of its own on top of the algebra input: it makes the base affine and reduced, covers X by finitely many affines with finite modules, introduces one auxiliary finite module M_ij for each pair of chart intersections so that those intersections can be controlled, intersects the finitely many dense opens produced by the algebra input, and then localises once more at a chosen point to read off the four flatness and finite presentation statements together with quasi-separatedness of X over S (proof lines 5262-5343). It is H2: the deep flatness input is the cited algebra lemma, while the contribution of this argument is the geometric assembly, which is carried out in the counted span and is not a citation.

expected.title: Every fppf covering is refined by a locally quasi-finite flat finite presentation covering
expected.author: The Stacks Project Authors
expected.difficulty_reason: Given an fppf covering of a scheme S, the lemma produces a refining fppf covering all of whose maps are locally quasi-finite, i.e. the locally quasi-finite flat finite presentation maps already generate the fppf topology. The retained proof is written out: for each s in S pick an index i with s in the image of S_i -> S, apply the neighbourhood lemma (lemma-qf-fp-flat-neighbourhood-dominates-fppf) to get a map g_s : T_s -> S that is flat, locally of finite presentation, locally quasi-finite, has s in its image and factors through S_i -> S, and verify the resulting family {T_s -> S} is an fppf covering refining the original one. Retained author proof at lines 6476-6484.

expected.title: Through every point of the image of a flat finitely presented map there is a locally quasi-finite flat chart
expected.author: The Stacks Project Authors
expected.difficulty_reason: Given a flat, locally finitely presented morphism f : X -> S and a point s in the image, the lemma produces a commutative triangle with g : S' -> S flat, locally of finite presentation and locally quasi-finite, with s in the image of g and a map S' -> X over S, i.e. an fppf chart of s that is moreover locally quasi-finite and lands inside X. The retained proof is written out in three moves: the fibre X_s is nonempty, the open-ness-of-CM-locus lemma for flat finite presentation supplies a closed point x of X_s where f is Cohen-Macaulay, and the CM slice lemma then yields Z -> S etale-in-the-slice sense through x; setting S' = Z concludes. Retained author proof at lines 6451-6458.
